work.title: Kora
work.tagline: Your bookshelf, narrator, and morning paper. All in one place.
work.description: Open-source ebook reader, audiobook player, and news aggregator with on-device text-to-speech. Read EPUB, PDF, and TXT; listen with neural voices; browse RSS feeds; sync across devices; and works offline as a PWA on web and Android.
work.coverAlt: Kora — reader, narrator, and morning paper in one app
highlights: EPUB, PDF, and TXT reading with offline PWA support
On-device narrator with Web Speech API and Android TTS
RSS morning paper with daily news brief and save flows

work.coverAlt: CookXpert — AI recipe manager and cooking companion UI

Meal guides, discovery search, and shared recipe database
Fridge tracker, themes, and Android APK distribution
